mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) directly signals stronger consumer spending, which boosts corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it triggers immediate market repricing of discount rates, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that elevates consumer spending and corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, with Rank IC below 0.05 in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals overcapacity and inflationary pressures, prompting central bank intervention that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion despite INDPRO growth exceeding 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL erodes real corporate profits and accelerates expectations of rate hikes, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and recession risk, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer and business confidence, accelerating earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, with Rank IC below 0.05 in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), higher discount rates reduce equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles.
